decisions: ButtonGroup maps all three actual exports and imports its real Button styling dependency. Native grouped-button outer corners come from the measured 10px default master; connected edges are logical rather than tied to specimen position labels. The source default horizontal CVA class exists even when data-orientation is omitted, so CSS follows actual orientation classes. Source Separator 1.9 uses data-orientation, not the data-horizontal/data-vertical utility names left in the pinned wrapper. Text addon chrome is an explicit reference with intrinsic height stretched to adjacent buttons and 10px inset; no fake Group size prop is added. Buttons retain their own sizes, states and keyboard/focus semantics. The group has no roving tabindex, toolbar role, group disabled state or selection API. Callers name the group and disable individual children; logical connected corners support explicit RTL.

Semantic token scalar values are meaningful reusable metrics, never coordinate-keyed specimen dimensions. Widths in native specimen grids remain evidence unless explicitly adopted as a domain layout constraint.
